exposure: Indications for LSCS (e.g., previous LSCS, CPD, fetal distress)
cohort: The study included 542 patients who underwent caesarean section out of 3156 institutional deliveries at Arokya Womens Centre, Salem, Tamil Nadu, South India.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 17.1% and the primary caesarean section rate was 8.01% in the hospital, with Group 5 and Group 2 contributing the highest to primary caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The primary caesarean section rate was 8.01%, with previous LSCS and fetal distress identified as common indications.
